In May 2026, the World Health Organization, the Arab League, and the United Nations Development Programme reviewed a fictional Regional Resilience Fund. The fund listed 42 delegates, 18 percent growth in vaccination outreach, and 3.5 million dollars for cold-chain equipment.

The same briefing warned that exact numbers must be reported carefully. It named Dr. Lina Haddad as the chair of the technical meeting and said that food-security logistics would be audited every quarter.
